objective: Read-only evidence-trace audit that follows one claimed behavior from source contract through runtime copy, artifacts, and validation proof.

steps.task: Trace the parent-copied behavior claim through schemas, planning, runtime state, result formatting, and rendering source. Do not edit or run commands. Return canonical owners, state transitions, and unclear edges.

Review artifact and output-retention paths relevant to the parent-copied behavior claim. Do not edit or run commands. Return where evidence is written, where it is summarized, what cleanup deletes, and what proof should be preserved.

Review README, skill, cookbook, and result-format operator copy for the parent-copied behavior claim. Do not edit. Return stale copy, missing headless/API guidance, and wording that could overstate proof.
Synthesize an evidence trace with one row per source-to-artifact-to-copy link. Mark each link pass, mismatch, missing proof, or deferred, and recommend the smallest validation command set.
